# filmopen_dictation

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

### `lib/src/dictate_button.dart`

- **class `DictationLook`** — How every microphone of the app looks and behaves, decided here and nowhere else (Software Specification §9.6).

- **function** `Widget dictateShortName(BuildContext context, ShortNameBox box, {required String identifier, UsagePurpose? purpose})` — A [ShortNameField]'s suffix: the microphone for the box, following the box's own rules (§9.6).

  - `const DictateButton({ super.key, required this.target, this.enabled = true, this.webBuild = kIsWeb, })` — Places the shared microphone on an editable box without configuring its look.

  - `final bool enabled` — Whether the box can be typed into now.
  - `final bool webBuild` — Whether this is the web build, which shows no microphone.

- **enum `DictationPhase`** — Where a dictation is (Software Specification §9.6).
  - values: `idle`, `connecting`, `listening`, `stopped`, `ended`, `failed`
- **class `DictationController`** — One dictation's microphone, transcription sessions, usage chains and timers (§9.6).
  - `DictationController({ required DictationSetup setup, this.creditSetup, required this.language, required this.app, this.purpose, this.owner = 'dicta…` — Creates a dictation lifecycle with an independent, nonsecret microphone owner kind.
  - `final DictationSetup selected` — The person's chosen speech service, whose own key is read first (§9.6).
  - `final DictationSetup? creditSetup` — The catalogue's OpenAI setup, on which a session opens on FilmOpen credit where [selected] has no key (§9.6).
  - `DictationSetup get setup` — The setup the session in use runs on: [creditSetup] where it fell back to OpenAI on credit, else [selected].
  - `final String language` — What the platform listens for: the app's language.
  - `final String app` — The app's version, which every record names (§6.7).
  - `final UsagePurpose? purpose` — The project, the entity and the box the text is for, which every record names; never the text.
  - `final String owner` — The nonsecret capture kind, independent of the Usage field or its identity.
  - `String? get microphoneBusyOwner` — The occupied owner's captured kind, localized without exposing an arbitrary identifier.
  - `String? get deviceId` — The microphone chosen in the menu, or null for the system's default.
  - `final Duration noSpeechLimit` — How long a session may hear no speech before it stops.
  - `final Duration sessionLimit` — How long the platform keeps a session open.
  - `final Duration warningBefore` — How long before [sessionLimit] the controller raises [nearLimit].
  - `final Duration captureStopLimit` — How long a recording's stop is waited for: past it the stop is logged as failed and the microphone is released.
  - `static ExactDecimal minutesOf(int frames)` — [frames] of audio in minutes, to the six places §6.7 allows, rounded half up in whole numbers.
  - `bool get capturing` — Whether returned microphone capture is still awaiting a completed stop.
  - `Future<void> get captureStopped` — Completes when pending microphone starts and all returned captures have stopped or been released after a failed stop.
  - `DictationPhase get phase` — Where the dictation is.
  - `String? get code` — Why the dictation failed, or why its last session ended by itself (`no_speech`, `time_limit`, `dropped`).
  - `bool get nearLimit` — Whether the session is within [warningBefore] of its end.
  - `bool get settled` — Whether every turn committed has its final text.
  - `bool get ending` — Whether a session's end has come while its last record is still being written (§9.6).
  - `List<DictationTurn> get turns` — Every turn so far, the earlier sessions' first.
  - `String get text` — Every turn's text so far, joined by a space.
  - `ValueListenable<int> get commits` — How many commits this dictation has sent — the device's, a [cut]'s, a [stop]'s — each counted as it is sent, before any answer can come; and every turn the platform ended by itself while no commit waited, counted when…
  - `ValueListenable<double> get level` — The current frame's loudness, 0..1 against the room's level as the speech gate judges it: a quarter at the level it hears as speech, 1 at four times that.
  - `Stream<DictationStretch> get stretches` — For every count of [commits], in its order, the words that ended there, once they have come: each count is answered exactly once, with an empty text where nothing came.
  - `Duration get audioSent` — The audio sent, over every session of this dictation.
  - `Money? get cost` — What that audio costs at the catalogue's price; null on FilmOpen credit, where the receipt alone says (§6.6).
  - `bool get onCredit` — Whether the session in use is on FilmOpen credit (§6.6).
  - `Future<void> listen()` — Starts a new session while preserving earlier text and joining an already pending start.
  - `Future<void> stop()` — Stops sending audio and joins physical microphone shutdown before releasing ownership.
  - `void cut()` — Ends the turn in progress, as [stop] does, and keeps the microphone on: the next frame begins the next turn.
  - `Future<void> settle({Duration timeout = const Duration(seconds: 3)})` — Stops audio and waits at most [timeout] for the final text of every committed turn.
  - `Future<void> resume()` — Reacquires the microphone after cleanup in the same session and chain, or starts a new session.
  - `Future<void> useDevice(String? device)` — Records from [device] from now on, null being the system's default.
  - `Future<bool> close()` — Ends text and Usage within a bounded wait and stops the microphone; repeated closes join the first.

### `lib/src/speech_gate.dart`

- **enum `TurnEnd`** — How the audio since the last turn ends (Software Specification §9.6).
  - values: `commit`, `clear`, `quiet`
- **typedef** `typedef GateStep` — What the gate made of one frame: its level, whether it held speech, and how the audio ended with it, if it did.
- **class `SpeechGate`** — Decides on the device where the turns of speech end: `gpt-live-transcribe` takes no voice activity detection of its own, only commits.
  - `SpeechGate({ this.quietToEnd = 8, this.speechToKeep = 2, this.longestTurn = 300, this.idleToClear = 100, this.loudness = 3, this.roomLeast = 50, th…`
  - `final int quietToEnd` — Frames of quiet after speech that end a turn: 0.8 s.
  - `final int speechToKeep` — Frames of speech a turn needs to be committed: 0.2 s, a short name.
  - `final int longestTurn` — Frames after a turn's first speech at which it ends without a pause: 30 s.
  - `final int idleToClear` — Frames of quiet, with no speech, after which their audio is cleared: 10 s.
  - `final double loudness` — How many times louder than the room a frame must be to count as speech.
  - `final double roomLeast` — The least the room's level is taken to be, on the 16-bit scale, and where it starts.
  - `final double roomRise` — The most the room's level rises in a frame: 3 %, about 2.6 dB a second.
  - `final int rangeFrames` — Frames whose range decides whether a voice holds the room down: 2 s.
  - `final int evenAfter` — Frames of speech from which a turn's evenness is judged: 1 s.
  - `final double variation` — How many times louder than the quietest frame the loudest must be for the sound to be a voice.
  - `static double levelOf(Uint8List frame)` — The level of a frame of 16-bit little-endian PCM: the root of its samples' mean square.
  - `double get room` — The room's level now.
  - `bool get pending` — Whether the turn in progress holds speech that no commit has taken yet.
  - `GateStep add(Uint8List frame)` — Measures [frame], and says how loud it was, whether it held speech and how the audio ended with it, if it did.
  - `TurnEnd? finish()` — Ends the turn in progress where the audio stops — *Stop*, or the text being applied.
  - `void reset()` — Forgets the turn in progress and the recent frames, for audio that starts again; the room's level is kept.
